split_rule: scenario-disjoint train/validation/test; no overlapping windows from one run cross splits
benchmark_rule: logistic baseline uses the same current-state features and future targets; world model receives six sequential states
runtime_authority: advisory only until local acceptance gates pass
notes: Exact epochs and learned metrics are persisted inside the artifact metadata/metrics files.
